purpose: Deterministic issue fixtures for supported door evidence and egress rules.

cases.title: Model without door elements
cases.description: The model has valid spatial structure but no IfcDoor, so door rules have no applicable target.

cases.title: Confirmed exit has no name
cases.description: IfcDoor.Name is missing while the explicit exit classification is present.

cases.title: Exit classification is missing
cases.description: The door is named like an exit but Pset_DoorCommon.FireExit is not populated.

cases.title: Exit classification cannot be normalized
cases.description: The model contains a non-boolean classification value and the engine must not infer applicability.

cases.title: Confirmed exit has no fire rating
cases.description: A confirmed exit door is missing Pset_DoorCommon.FireRating evidence.

cases.title: Fire rating is an empty string
cases.description: The fire-rating property exists but contains no usable value.

cases.title: Exit has no measured clear width
cases.description: The model has only nominal OverallWidth; the engine must not treat it as verified clear opening.

cases.title: Only nominal width is available
cases.description: The model reports OverallWidth but omits Pset_BIMReview.ClearWidth, so the mainland pre-check must return REVIEW.

cases.title: Clear width is below 800 mm
cases.description: The explicit clear width is 799 mm, below the configured GB 55037-2022 pre-check threshold.

cases.title: Clear width is below the demonstration threshold
cases.description: The explicit clear width is 899 mm, below the demo pack's 900 mm threshold.

cases.title: Clear width is zero
cases.description: A non-positive measured width is invalid evidence and must not become a passing comparison.

cases.title: Clear width is negative
cases.description: A negative width value is invalid evidence and should be surfaced for correction.

cases.title: Hong Kong capacity evidence is missing
cases.description: A confirmed exit has width evidence but no occupant capacity to select a Table B2 row.

cases.title: Hong Kong capacity is fractional
cases.description: Table B2 requires an integer occupant count; 30.5 cannot select a deterministic row.

cases.title: Hong Kong capacity is outside the direct-check range
cases.description: A capacity above the directly machine-checkable Table B2 rows requires authority or professional review.

cases.title: Capacity 30 with a 749 mm clear opening
cases.description: This boundary case is one millimetre below the 750 mm minimum for 4–30 occupants.

cases.title: Capacity 31 with an 849 mm clear opening
cases.description: This boundary case is one millimetre below the 850 mm minimum for 31–200 occupants.

cases.title: Name suggests exit but property says non-exit
cases.description: The explicit non-exit property conflicts with exit-related naming metadata.

cases.title: Internal door has no name
cases.description: All doors are subject to the configured information check, including non-exit doors.

cases.title: Exit is missing several required fields
cases.description: The exit has no name, fire rating, clear width, or occupant capacity evidence.
